text: Each year, the TTC prepares an Annual Report, which presents the consolidated financial statements of the TTC and its subsidiaries as well as non-financial statement information, including: Chair’s Message, CEO’s Message, Annual Highlights, Management’s Statement, Statistical Information, and the Management Directory. This report presents the materials other than the financial statements, which will be included in the 2025 TTC Annual Report. The 2025 Consolidated Financial Statements have been submitted for the Audit, Finance and Risk Management Committee consideration through the companion report, “Draft Consolidated Financial Statements of Toronto Transit Commission for the Year Ended December 31, 2025”.
The Audit, Finance and Risk Management Committee: 1. Approved the non-financial statement information to be published in the 2025 Toronto Transit Commission Annual Report.
